title: '~01' is unescaped to '/' instead of '~1'
body:
RFC 6901 section 4 requires "~1" to be replaced by "/" first and "~0"
by "~" second, so that "~01" becomes the literal "~1". `unescape` in
`jsonpointer.py` does it in the other order:

```python
>>> resolve_pointer({"a~1b": 1, "a/b": 2}, "/a~01b")
2      # expected 1
>>> JsonPointer("/~01").parts
['/']  # expected ['~1']
```

Expected: pointers decode as RFC 6901 specifies, and
`JsonPointer.from_parts(parts).parts == parts` for any keys,
including ones that contain "~", "/" or "~1".
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file
